description:
Required Qualifications: 
 Minimum of 3 years of development in BizTalk
 Minimum of 1-2 years of working experience with ESB toolkit (1.0, 2.0 or 2.1) and itinerary design and implementation, resolvers, exception handling framework
 Good knowledge of MS SQL Server
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Minimum of 3 years of working experience with BizTalk (2006+) development and messaging design patterns, orchestrations, pipelines, adapters and convoys 
 Application or coding experience using Microsoft Visual Studio platform
 Experience/knowledge with XML, HL7, X12, or other industry transaction/protocol formats
 Good knowledge of MS technologies: TFS, SharePoint
 Experience with implementing Business Rules Engine (BRE)
 Knowledge of Web Services (SOAP/WSDL) Restful state services, Windows Communications Foundation (WCF)
 Experience integrating with real-time and web services interfaces
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ month
